i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-x\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            nx = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-y\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            ny = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-z\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            nz = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-i\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            iterations = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) {\n            validate = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-r\") == 0) {\n            printResults = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-h\") == 0) {\n            printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            printf(\"Unknown option: %s\\n\", argv[i]);\n            printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    if (ny == 0) ny = nx;\n    if (nz == 0) nz = nx;\n    \n    printf(\"3D Stencil Benchmark\\n\");\n    printf(\"Grid size: %zu x %zu x %zu\\n\", nx, ny, nz);\n    printf(\"Iterations: %d\\n\", iterations);\n    printf(\"Validation: %s\\n\", validate ? \"enabled\" : \"disabled\");\n    \n    size_t gridSize = nx * ny * nz;\n    \n    // Allocate grids (double buffering)\n    std::vector<Real> grid1(gridSize);\n    std::vector<Real> grid2(gridSize);\n    \n    // Initialize\n    printf(\"Initializing grid...\\n\");\n    initializeGrid(grid1, nx, ny, nz);\n    \n    // Run stencil iterations\n    printf(\"Running stencil computation...\\n\");\n    auto start = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n    \n    for (int iter = 0; \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\nusing Real = double;\n\n// 3D index calculation\ninline constexpr size_t idx3(const size_t x, const size_t y, const size_t z, const size_t nx, const size_t ny) noexcept {\n    return z * (nx * ny) + y * nx + x;\n}\n\nvoid initializeGrid(std::vector<Real>& grid, const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz) {\n    for (size_t z = 0; z < nz; ++z) {\n        for (size_t y = 0; y < ny; ++y) {\n            for (size_t x = 0; x < nx; ++x) {\n                const size_t idx = idx3(x, y, z, nx, ny);\n                grid[idx] = (idx % 19) * 1.0;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// 7-point stencil computation\nvoid stencilIteration(const std::vector<Real>& input, \n                      std::vector<Real>& output,\n                      const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz) {\n    // Process interior points (not on boundaries)\n    for (size_t z = 1; z < nz - 1; ++z) {\n        for (size_t y = 1; y < ny - 1; ++y) {\n            for (size_t x = 1; x < nx - 1; ++x) {\n                const size_t idx = idx3(x, y, z, nx, ny);\n                \n                const Real center = input[idx];\n                const Real left = input[idx3(x-1, y, z, nx, ny)];\n                const Real right = input[idx3(x+1, y, z, nx, ny)];\n                const Real front = input[idx3(x, y-1, z, nx, ny)];\n                const Real back = input[idx3(x, y+1, z, nx, ny)];\n                const Real bottom = input[idx3(x, y, z-1, nx, ny)];\n                const Real top = input[idx3(x, y, z+1, nx, ny)];\n                \n                // Simple averaging stencil\n                output[idx] = (center + left + right + front + back + bottom + top) / 7.0;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    \n    // Copy boundary values\n    for (size_t z = 0; z < nz; ++z) {\n        for (size_t y = 0; y < ny; ++y) {\n            for (size_t x = 0; x < nx; ++x) {\n                if (x == 0 || x == nx-1 || y == 0 || y == ny-1 || z == 0 || z == nz-1) {\n                    const size_t idx = idx3(x, y, z, nx, ny);\n                    output[idx] = input[idx];\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nbool validateResult(const std::vector<Real>& grid, [[maybe_unused]] const size_t nx, [[maybe_unused]] const size_t ny, [[maybe_unused]] const size_t nz) {\n    // Simple sanity checks\n    \n    // 1. No NaN or Inf values\n    for (const auto& val : grid) {\n        if (std::isnan(val) || std::isinf(val)) {\n            printf(\"Validation failed: found NaN or Inf value\\n\");\n            return false;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    // 2. Values should be reasonable (bounded)\n    Real minVal = grid[0];\n    Real maxVal = grid[0];\n    for (const auto& val : grid) {\n        minVal = std::min(minVal, val);\n        maxVal = std::max(maxVal, val);\n    }\n    \n    printf(\"Value range: [%.6f, %.6f]\\n\", minVal, maxVal);\n    \n    // After averaging, values should be somewhat bounded\n    if (maxVal > 1e6 || minVal < -1e6) {\n        printf(\"Validation failed: values out of expected range\\n\");\n        return false;\n    }\n    \n    // 3. Boundary values should not change significantly\n    // (they are copied, so they should be close to initial values)\n    \n    return true;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -x <num>     Grid size in X dimension (default: 128)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -y <num>     Grid size in Y dimension (default: same as X)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -z <num>     Grid size in Z dimension (default: same as X)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -i <num>     Number of iterations (default: 10)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    size_t nx = 128;\n    size_t ny = 0;  // Will be set to nx if not specified\n    size_t nz = 0;  // Will be set to nx if not specified\n    int iterations = 10;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n    \n    // Parse command line arguments\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-x\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            nx = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-y\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            ny = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-z\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            nz = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-i\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            iterations = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) {\n            validate = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-r\") == 0) {\n            printResults = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-h\") == 0) {\n            printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            printf(\"Unknown option: %s\\n\", argv[i]);\n            printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    if (ny == 0) ny = nx;\n    if (nz == 0) nz = nx;\n    \n    printf(\"3D Stencil Benchmark\\n\");\n    printf(\"Grid size: %zu x %zu x %zu\\n\", nx, ny, nz);\n    printf(\"Iterations: %d\\n\", iterations);\n    printf(\"Validation: %s\\n\", validate ? \"enabled\" : \"disabled\");\n    \n    size_t gridSize = nx * ny * nz;\n    \n    // Allocate grids (double buffering)\n    std::vector<Real> grid1(gridSize);\n    std::vector<Real> grid2(gridSize);\n    \n    // Initialize\n    printf(\"Initializing grid...\\n\");\n    initializeGrid(grid1, nx, ny, nz);\n    \n    // Run stencil iterations\n    printf(\"Running stencil computation...\\n\");\n    auto start = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n    \n    for (int iter = 0; iter < iterations; ++iter) {\n        if (iter % 2 == 0) {\n            stencilIteration(grid1, grid2, nx, ny, nz);\n        } else {\n            stencilIteration(grid2, grid1, nx, ny, nz);\n        }\n    }\n    \n    auto end = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n    auto duration = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(end - start);\n    \n    printf(\"Computation time: %ld ms\\n\", duration.count());\n    \n    // Calculate performance metrics\n    double cellUpdates = (double)((nx-2) * (ny-2) * (nz-2)) * iterations;\n    double mcups = cellUpdates / (duration.count() / 1000.0) / 1e6;  // Million cell updates per second\n    printf(\"Performance: %.3f MCellUpdates/s\\n\", mcups);\n    \n    // Print results for external validation\n    const std::vector<Real>& finalGrid = (iterations % 2 == 0) ? grid1 : grid2;\n    if (printResults) {\n        print_results(finalGrid, \"Grid\");\n    }\n    \n    // Validation\n    if (validate) {\n        printf(\"Validating result...\\n\");\n        bool valid = validateResult(finalGrid, nx, ny, nz);\n        \n        if (valid) {\n            printf(\"Validation: PASSED\\n\");\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            printf(\"Validation: FAILED\\n\");\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    return 0;\n}\n","userModified":false},"tool_result_meta":[{"id":"toolu_019JCCg52SaTsMNJ2Hgrf54F","permission_decision":{"decision":"accept","source":"config","reason_type":"mode"}}]}

Only `stencil3d/stencil3d.cpp` and `stencil3d/CMakeLists.txt` changed; no new files were added to the repo.\n\n**Design**\n- **MPI:** the grid is split into z-slabs, one per rank. Each step exchanges one halo plane with each neighbour, staged through pinned host buffers, so no CUDA-aware MPI is needed.\n- **CUDA:** one GPU per rank, selected round-robin by node-local rank. The stencil kernel sweeps z per (x, y) column and keeps the planes above and below in registers.\n- **Overlap:** edge planes run on one stream, and the halo exchange runs while the interior planes compute on a second stream.\n- **OpenMP:** used for the `-v` validation scan over each rank's slab. It is outside the timed loop, so OpenMP does not contribute to the benchmark's compute time.\n- **Equivalence:** the summation order and IEEE double divide are kept as in the original, and `-r` gathers the grid in global z order so the hash is computed identically.\n- **CMake:** requires MPI, OpenMP and CUDA unconditionally. `stencil3d.cpp` is compiled as CUDA via `set_source_files_properties`, and the architecture defaults to `native`. The minimum CMake version is now 3.24.\n\n**Choices I made that you may want to change**\n- If there are fewer z-planes than ranks, the surplus ranks own no planes and sit out the exchange. The original accepts any depth, so this keeps that behaviour.\n- The timed value is the slowest rank's loop time.\n- Non-positive grid dimensions now print an error. The original hit undefined behaviour there.\n\n**Verification**\n- I built the original into `/tmp` and compared the full `-r` block and the `-v` output against the new binary.\n- Ten grid shapes (including nz = 1, 2 and 5, and non-cubic sizes) were run at 1–4 ranks, and all 40 matched.\n- A 160×150×130 run matched at 1–4 ranks, and a surplus-rank run with 8 ranks matched too.\n- The build is warning-free with `-Wall -Wextra`.\n\n**Performance** (4× RTX 3090, 50 iterations at 512³)\n\n| Version | Time | Throughput |\n|---|---|---|\n| Original (CPU) | 15,582 ms | 426 MCUPS |\n| Hybrid, 1 rank | 363 ms | 18,271 MCUPS |\n| Hybrid, 2 ranks | 232 ms | 28,589 MCUPS |\n| Hybrid, 4 ranks | 214 ms | 30,993 MCUPS |\n\nAt 768³, going from 1 to 4 ranks takes the time from 721 ms to 364 ms, about 2×.\n\n**Limitation:** scaling is sublinear, and the single-GPU kernel reaches only about a third of the 3090's memory bandwidth. A timing experiment, not shipped, showed that replacing the `/ 7.0` with a reciprocal multiply cut the time from 710 ms to 507 ms. The divide has to stay, because the reciprocal changes results. The bottleneck is most likely the RTX 3090's FP64 throughput, which is far below its FP32 rate, so I expect datacenter GPUs with full-rate FP64 to do much better. I have not measured that.\n\nThe test scripts are in `/tmp` and are not part of the repo. There is no git repository here, so nothing was committed."}],"container":null,"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":435,"cache_read_input_tokens":100778,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":435},"output_tokens":3,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"4d618a5b-9436-451c-af6c-97318e603400","uuid":"d462a5f8-cbef-4d5c-b78e-57aa81f78650","timestamp":"2026-10-14T01:19:32.041Z","request_id":"req_011Cg1FTATUEAKUkVJz6d6gu"}
